title: Across land, sea, and mountains: sulphate aerosol sources and transport dynamics over the northern Apennines
content:
Environ. Sci.: Atmos., 2025, 5,1023-1034
DOI: 10.1039/D5EA00035A, Paper

Manuel Bettineschi, Bruno Vitali, Arineh Cholakian, Dino Zardi, Federico Bianchi, Victoria Sinclair, Johannes Mikkola, Paolo Cristofanelli, Angela Marinoni, Martina Mazzini, Liine Heikkinen, Minna Aurela, Marco Paglione, Bertrand Bessagnet, Paolo Tuccella, Giancarlo Ciarelli
Marine air masses enhance SO2 oxidation due to elevated OH concentrations over the sea, increasing sulphate levels at Monte Cimone. Industrial emissions remain the major source, even during sea-dominated transport.
